entities.name: Dóra Maurer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dóra Maurer was a Hungarian visual artist associated with conceptual art and geometric abstraction whose career spanned more than five decades. Working across drawing, printmaking, photography, film, painting, installation, and performance, Maurer developed systems-based artworks exploring transformation, seriality, and the perception of movement and time. Dóra Maurer was a painters & sculptors from Budapest (1937-06-11, Budapest–2026-02-14). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
